title: AuditEventPage
description: `GET /audit-events`: the account facts, read — devices, rules, conversations, undos, file writes (plan 06, B-40; plan 07, B-17).

items.description: One fact, as the client sees it. The owner is the caller, so it is not here.

kind.description: A genuinely open vocabulary — `file.`, `file.written`, a device or a rule event — never a fixed enum.

subjectId.description: What the fact is about — for a file, its real path.

subjectLabel.description: How to show the subject — for a file, its path relative to the open folder.

details.description: Sizes, hashes, origin and destination, counts — never the contents of a file. Open: shaped by the kind.

nextCursor.description: Opaque to the client: send it back as `cursor`. `null` on the last page.
